tmp:1441: shye'yitrachaku me-hagadlut ad katzeh acharon — the required action of distancing oneself from arrogance/self-aggrandizement to the utmost extreme, precondition for returning to the Land of Israel
tmp:1442: kavod nitgaleh — the state of divine glory becoming revealed, effected through Torah wisdom that rectifies and restores the soul to its root
tmp:1443: teshuvah al teshuvato — the second, higher repentance done upon one's first repentance after attaining greater perception of God's exaltedness; corresponds to the honor of the World to Come
tmp:1444: kevod olam hazeh — the honor of this world, the level corresponding to first/initial repentance (as opposed to World-to-Come honor of the second teshuvah)
tmp:1445: kevodo nit'aleh — the state of God's glory being elevated, accomplished through Torah acquired via humility, in proportion to one's breaking of pride (Mount Tabor teaching)
tmp:1446: clearing the mochin (mental faculties) of external/secular wisdoms and foreign thoughts — the 'chametz-removal' of the mind required so the voice striking the brain produces thunder
tmp:1447: the quarrel and strife (matzuta u-merivah) among the perfect tzaddikim — disputes between righteous ones that one must believe serve only holy purposes
tmp:1448: the purpose of tzaddikim's quarrels: to drive away the sitrin achranin (the Other Sides, forces of impurity)
tmp:1449: the requirement to join love (ahavah/chesed) with the gevurot that are the aspect of thunders — combining left in right so thunder-voice is produced
tmp:1451: the requirement to combine love (ahavah) with fear/awe (yirah) — pairing right-side chesed with left-side gevurah in divine service
tmp:1452: the goal 'so that thunders (re'amim) be produced' — thunder as the outcome of joining love with fear, the voice striking the purified brain
tmp:1453: the teaching that the quarrel among tzaddikim exists 'only for your sake' — as a personal rebuke for one's damaged brain-drops (seminal blemish)
tmp:1455: ruach dil'ela — the 'spirit above,' the upper of the two spirits corresponding to koach (potential) as against the lower spirit of actuality
tmp:1456: techilat ha-machashavah — the initial thought preceding a deed ('end of action in thought first'), the aspect of potential (koach) before actualization
tmp:1458: receiving 'this power' from Edom — appropriating from Edom the coercive force needed (to punish the wicked) in order to reach the Land of Israel
tmp:1459: the power to punish the wicked (with sword and slaughter) — the coercive force for subduing the slanderers of the Land who prolong exile
tmp:1461: chalom — the dream as manifestation of the koach ha-medammeh (imaginative faculty), which seeks to rest upon one who reviews halakhot
tmp:1464: chakhmei ha-dor — the Sages of the generation, sole authorized interpreters of Torah via the thirteen hermeneutical principles
tmp:1465: the healing power received from the Torah — Torah's remedy 'to all his flesh,' accessible only through the generation's Sages who expound it
tmp:1467: the state in which all souls yearn to be included in his soul — the magnetism of one who guards his soul/name from anger and enlarges the wall of wealth
tmp:1468: kol ha-kolot dikdushah — all the holy voices/sounds, identified with azut dikdushah (holy boldness)
tmp:1469: azei panim — the brazen-faced ones of the generation who seize fallen honor (kingship without a crown) when eating-lust blemishes Malkhut
tmp:1470: kelavim azei nefesh — 'greedy-souled dogs' (Isaiah 56:11), the dog-image of the brazen-faced ('face of the generation like the face of a dog,' Sotah 49b)
tmp:1471: kulo echad — 'entirely one,' the total unity that is the aspect of emet (truth), opposite of falsehood which stems from distance from Oneness
tmp:1473: kulo ha-tov ve-hameitiv — the future state when all blessing will be 'Who is good and does good,' identified with the single eye of mercy (eina chad de-rachamei) of the Idra
tmp:1474: kulo tov — 'entirely good,' the ultimate purpose (tachlit) of Oneness, per 'on that day Hashem will be one' (Zechariah 14:9; Pesachim 50a)
tmp:1475: klei holadah — the organs/vessels of procreation, linked to shevarim and to trust ('Shall I bring to the breaking-point and not give birth?' Isaiah 66:9)
tmp:1477: kelayot — the kidneys as bodily organs, counted as the vessels of procreation and the seat of bitachon (trust)
tmp:1479: kelalut ha-gevanin — the totality/inclusion of all the colors, defining the sefirah Tiferet (attribute of Yaakov/emet)
tmp:1481: the chasadim within the body/torso — kindnesses clothed in all the middot, the embodied loves comprising the totality of the traits
tmp:1482: kelaliut ha-middot — the all-inclusiveness of the character traits, in each of which chesed/love is clothed
tmp:1483: kelaliut ha-kedushah — the totality of holiness, the supra-natural providential state attained via the Land of Israel which contains all ten holinesses
tmp:1484: kelaliut shivah ro'im — the collectivity of the Seven Shepherds (Abraham through David), embodied in the true tzaddikim
tmp:1485: the power and fervor of the beginning — the initial burst of enthusiasm ('all beginnings are hard') that sets the measure of one's ongoing service
tmp:1486: the principle that one's ongoing conduct in divine service proceeds according to [his beginning] — each visit to the tzaddik must therefore be made totally anew
tmp:1487: corresponding to the four kingdoms-in-holiness (arba malkhuyot shebikdushah) — the holy counterparts of the four exiles, mapped onto the Haggadah's four sons
tmp:1488: Canaan eved avadim — 'Canaan, slave of slaves' (Genesis 9:25), epithet of the serpent whose banishment on Motzaei Shabbat (Eliyahu's revelation) repels the slaves' sleep
tmp:1489: hitlabshut — enclothement/garbing, identified with 'kanaf' (wing/covering), per 'your Teacher shall no longer be covered (yikanef)' (Isaiah 30:20)
tmp:1491: kenafayim — the 'wings' aroused by clapping hands in prayer, the source from which speech issues ('a winged creature shall tell the matter,' Ecclesiastes 10:20)
tmp:1493: kisei kavod — the Throne of Glory, symbolized by the circular letter samekh (numerical 60), linked to 'sixty queens' and nullification of the forbidden in sixty
